synergy_evidence.cv_excerpt: focused on Deep Graph CNN for Non-rigid registration and matching. Projecting Hippocampus shape into the pre-shape space based on Kendall’s definition, and  then into the shape space in order to ensure accurate geodesic paths between shapes and invariance in parametrization. We then extracted Dense vector fields features in order to perform triple classification and exceeded all state of the art methods. We also determined most affected regions of Hippocampi by Alzheimer based on tangent vectors on geodesic distances.
